title: U4: TZ Arbitrage Lookback Sensitivity — 10d beats 5d
description: Phase U4 tested 8 lookback windows (1d-22d) for SPY momentum→Asia TZ arbitrage on Taiwan 0050.TW and Japan N225, 2018-2024. Key finding: 10d lookback dominates 5d — higher net Sharpe (TW 1.47 vs 1.14, JP 1.31 vs 1.07), lower turnover (29 vs 47 sw/yr), and both pass Harvey (t>3.0). Short lookbacks (1-3d) have high gross alpha but are TX-cost fragile (1d breaks even at 0.4%). Strategy robust across all lookbacks (CV<0.3) with 10d sweet spot. Sub-period analysis: 10d positive in all 4 sub-periods for Taiwan (0.97-2.19 Sharpe). Recommendation: upgrade default from 5d to 10d.
